def: The agent doing a job, for example editing code against a score and keeping edits that help.
The process that improves the inner agent by proposing rewrites and keeping those that beat the best version so far.
Weco's name for a system that improves itself more efficiently than humans improving the same system by hand.
A hand-tuned version of the same agent given the same budget and the same number of attempts as the loop.
The tendency of a candidate chosen for a high noisy score to look better than it really is, because the selection kept the lucky noise.
Data or tasks the proposer never sees and that never decide what is kept, used to measure the real gain.
A counter outside the agent that charges every dollar and step to a budget and refuses to exceed it.
A rank correlation between score and step number, equal to +1 when scores always rise.
The mean of the per-task differences between two arms divided by its standard error.
Estimating an interval by resampling the observed differences with replacement many times.
